description: LinkedIn Ad Library search (ads LinkedIn discloses publicly, including EU/EEA): up to 24 ads per page with ad id, advertiser, format (single image, video, carousel, document), creative type, tagline, ad text, links and detail link. Search by keyword and/or advertiser, optionally one country and a time window. From linkedin.com/ad-library via a residential proxy. Price: $0.01 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code where the ad ran, e.g. US, DE

keyword.description: Words in the ad, e.g. software, cybersecurity
